categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches src/bench/wallet_migration.cpp and test files only to adapt them to moved wallet symbols, which belongs to wallet rather than test infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Mechanical test adjustments following an internal wallet refactor do not make this a test infrastructure PR.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches core wallet files across src/wallet/, reorganizing legacy loading, migration logic, and LegacyDataSPKM into dedicated classes and directory.
categories.rationale: Extracts deprecated legacy wallet and migration code out of CWallet into an isolated legacy subsystem. As the author notes, 'co-mingling of never-to-be-changed legacy wallet code and new descriptor wallet code makes it difficult to implement new things into the wallet'; while a valuable architectural cleanup, it does not fix active user bugs or fund safety issues and is reasonably deferrable.
